code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]}
    comps=[]
    while pts:
        start=pts.pop(); comp={start}; stack=[start]
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in pts: pts.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    out=[[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    for comp in comps:
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        # T has a three-cell bar and a centered stem; stem direction determines color.
        rmin,rmax=min(rs),max(rs); cmin,cmax=min(cs),max(cs)
        barrow=next(r for r in range(rmin,rmax+1) if sum((r,c) in comp for c in range(cmin,cmax+1))==3)
        stem=3 if any((barrow-1,c) in comp for c in range(cmin,cmax+1)) else 1
        cy=(rmin+rmax)/2; cx=(cmin+cmax)/2
        rr=min(2,int(cy*3/h)); cc=min(5,int(cx*6/w))
        out[rr][cc]=stem
    return out
'''
